title: REQ · buildScene creates all scene entities purely from content in layer order
summary: buildScene turns a SceneSpec into ordered SceneObject entities
description: Context: scenes are defined in YAML content. Desired behavior: buildScene(ctx, scene) creates one SceneObject per scene object and returns them sorted by layer depth, grouped by layer, using no hardcoded ids. Expected result: the bedroom content yields entities across furniture and objects layers in order. Why: scene construction is data-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with objects on objects, furniture and background layers, when buildScene runs, then the returned list is ordered background, furniture, objects
Given a scene, when buildScene runs, then ctx.createSprite is called exactly once per object
Given an empty objects array, when buildScene runs, then it returns an empty result without error
technical_constraints: Stable order within the same layer
